# Find Jasper Skye artist_id
artist_query = 'Jasper Skye'
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
results = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.search_artists(query=artist_query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    print('page', page_index, 'resp', resp)
    # resp may be list
    if not resp:
        break
    results.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        # but still may have more pages; don't assume; continue until empty
        pass
    page_index += 1
print('total artists', len(results))
# try exact match
matches = [a for a in results if a.get('name','').lower() == artist_query.lower()]
print('exact matches', matches)
# take best match by name similarity if no exact
if matches:
    artist_id = matches[0]['artist_id']
else:
    artist_id = results[0]['artist_id'] if results else None
print('chosen artist_id', artist_id)

arguments.code:
artist_id=3
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_songs=[]
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.search_songs(query='', artist_id=artist_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-play_count')
    print('page', page_index, 'resp', resp)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('total songs', len(all_songs))
# Determine most played
if all_songs:
    max_play=max(s.get('play_count',0) for s in all_songs)
    top=[s for s in all_songs if s.get('play_count',0)==max_play]
    # choose first by maybe title
    top_sorted=sorted(top, key=lambda s:(s.get('title',''), s.get('song_id',0)))
    print('max_play', max_play)
    print('top candidates', top)
    print('chosen', top_sorted[0])
    result_title=top_sorted[0]['title']
else:
    result_title=None
print('result_title', result_title)
